title: worktrunk: add wts alias and wtp prune function
diff:
diff --git a/worktrunk/aliases.zsh b/worktrunk/aliases.zsh
new file mode 100644
index 00000000..1bd11a4f
--- /dev/null
+++ b/worktrunk/aliases.zsh
@@ -0,0 +1,29 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env zsh
+
+alias wts='wt switch'
+
+wtp () {
+  wt step prune "$@"
+
+  local branches
+  branches=$(wt list --format=json | jq -r '.[] | select(.is_main | not) | .branch')
+  [[ -z "$branches" ]] && return
+
+  local remote_host
+  remote_host=$(git remote get-url origin 2>/dev/null | sed -E 's|^[^@]*@||; s|^https?://||; s|[:/].*||')
+
+  local -a merged_branches
+  if [[ "$remote_host" == *gitlab* ]]; then
+    merged_branches=("${(@f)$(glab mr list --state merged --output json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.[].source_branch')}")
+  else
+    merged_branches=("${(@f)$(gh pr list --state merged --json headRefName --jq '.[].headRefName' 2>/dev/null)}")
+  fi
+
+  local branch
+  for branch in ${(f)branches}; do
+    if (( ${merged_branches[(Ie)$branch]} )); then
+      echo "Removing $branch (PR merged)"
+      wt remove --force --force-delete "$branch"
+    fi
+  done
+}
contextNote: Adds a wts shell alias for wt switch and a wtp function that prunes clean worktrees then force-removes worktrees whose GitHub PRs are already merged.
originalBody:
Adds `wts` as a shortcut for `wt switch` and a `wtp` function that extends `wt step prune` to handle dirty/stashed worktrees whose PRs have been merged on GitHub.

`wt step prune` skips worktrees with local modifications. `wtp` runs it first for clean worktrees, then checks remaining branches against GitHub PR state via `gh pr view` and force-removes any whose PR is merged.
